description.value: Floyd's Diner is a Victoria, BC institution established in 2004, best known for 'The Mahoney' — a large breakfast challenge that has become a local legend. The Royal Oak location on West Saanich Road is one of four family-friendly diners across greater Victoria. It offers a casual, welcoming atmosphere with a breakfast and lunch menu, making it a natural rest stop for cyclists exploring the Saanich Peninsula.
